provenance.basis: Assembly snippets authored for these tests, assembled independently before importing the decoder under test. Expected spans and raw bytes come from the assembler listing; operands come from the authored source and documented signed fields.
provenance.assembler: KASM 6.1.0 from official KINT6.3.0 development kit
provenance.host_port: Private Linux build changed host headers/file-I/O/time wrappers, DWORD typedef to uint32_t on LP64, and printf casts. Instruction-encoding routines were unchanged.
provenance.runtime_vector_basis: Literal QWORD bytes and documented/source-checked KINT6.3.0 instruction lengths; no assembler-generated expected span for the two inconsistent forms.
provenance.qualification: Static decoding and operand representation only. These vectors do not establish runtime arithmetic, host-service behavior, KINT6.4 compatibility, or whole-game equivalence.

vectors.encoding_note: KASM6.1.0 writes a QWORD after casting this source immediate to DWORD; the emitted high word is zero. This expectation concerns emitted bytes, not successful execution of the source intent.

assembler_discrepancies.reason: KASM6.1.0 emits one DWORD for this QWORD immediate; reference KINT6.3.0 consumes two DWORDs. The assembler span is not a valid instruction-length oracle for this form.
